items.question: How safe is [Country]?
items.answer: We felt very safe in Cambodia. We walked around Siem Reap past 10:00 PM. We also took a few inner lanes to one of our venues, which were more rustic than the tourist traps, but were also safe.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: At least in Siem Reap, the answer is yes.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in [Country]?
items.answer: Depending on when you go, the weather may play spoilsport, especially if you do the sunset tours as evening showers are more common during the monsoon.
